name: Microgrid voltage-reactive droop reference
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Identifies the selected relation between voltage reference and resource reactive contribution.
description: Identifies the selected relation between voltage reference and resource reactive contribution. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reactive contribution and droop data” at the input and “Adjusted voltage reference” at the output. Droop parameters require system-level validation.
